findings.what: Chosen/recommended fund shows a minus percentage (−0.04%) with no plain explanation; it reads like a loss
Every other fund shows a '−1,030 ₪'-style figure; the minus reads like losing money rather than 'less than your pick'
Colour key for the stacked bars only comes after all 15 accounts, so I guessed the colours while scrolling; red looked scary

The same 'לא בחישוב מחיר אחר לצעירים, לחיילים…' text repeats on almost every bank, so I kept re-reading it; it also hints I might get a cheaper price as a young person, and the page didn't work that out
Page defaults to 10,000 + 500, so the big number that sticks isn't my situation
Fund manager name אי.בי.אי. is not one I know, so I hesitated even though it's cheapest
Jargon in the fee lines (נאמן, דמי משמרת) with no plain explanation
